pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal - airy whisper + soft hum]
(soft pulsing pads, distant water-drop pluck, wide reverb, lonely night atmosphere)

Like a movie… it should’ve been beautiful…
But you were a storm… that left me blue…

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(behind-the-beat, breathy, locked to kick/snare)

Wanted a pretty ending like in the movies
But you swept through like a hurricane
Was this love only one-sided?
Another night wondering alone again

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(sub bass follows kick, minimal pads)

Even if it hurts, if it’s not love then what is?
I comfort myself with empty lies
Words I couldn’t say still remain in my chest
Scattered away with my trembling breath

[Hook]
[Female Vocal - phonetic loop]
(slight silence before, then full groove impact)

Talking to myself… in the dark
Calling your name… with a broken heart
It was love… it was love
To me… it was love

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(repeat hook with layered airy ad-libs)

Talking to myself… in the dark
Calling your name… with a broken heart
It was love… it was love
To me… it was love

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(more textured rasp, close mic)

Scenes I can’t rewind crash like waves
I stand alone in the time you left behind
If we had just passed by each other that day
Maybe it wouldn’t hurt this way

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(pads pulse stronger)

I know you’re not coming back
Still your warmth returns to my fingertips
Foolishly I remember you again
In this night full of regret

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(stronger groove, add light vocal fry)

Talking to myself… in the dark
Calling your name… with a broken heart
It was love… it was love
To me… it was love

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(full layers, humming in background)

Talking to myself… in the dark
Calling your name… with a broken heart
It was love… it was love
To me… it was love

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal - half-whisper]
(everything drops to sub bass + soft pads)

You left with my broken heart…
But I still whisper in the dark…

[Rap]
[Female Vocal - low, breathy, close]
(exact drum interlock, behind snare)

One word “love” can’t explain this pain
All the seasons bruised since the day you came
You’ll never hear these words I kept inside
But they still live in me, they won’t die
Even the scars you gave feel warm somehow
I say goodbye… but I don’t know how
Yeah… it was love…

[Break]
[Instrumental + Humming]
(only water-drop pluck + pulsing pads, airy hums)

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(max layers, rich reverb)

Talking to myself… in the dark
Even if you never hear my heart
It was love… it was love
To me… you were love

[Outro]
[Female Vocal - fading]
(heavy reverb, last syllable fry, slow fade)

It was love… to me…
(soft humming till end)
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
